en: A black‑and‑white multi‑view postcard featuring several landmarks of the city of Pécs. The front side shows six different photographs: an aerial view of a central square with a domed building; the richly decorated interior of a large church; a statue of a standing figure in a park; a round stone tower and old city wall; the façade of a four‑towered cathedral with a statue in front; and an ornate fountain or monument in a street scene. The word "PÉCS" is printed in bold capital letters in the center. The reverse side is a standard divided postcard back with address lines, stamp box, price, publisher, and the city name printed.
